description: This Java class defines the main activity for handling an inbox-style notification interface in an Android Wear application. It primarily manages the creation of the activity and cancels a predefined notification upon creation.

classes.name: InboxMainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for displaying an inbox notification, with functionality to cancel existing notifications when created.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method invoked when the activity is created; initializes UI and cancels the notification.
